objective_value: <float> Total weighted system cost combining electricity commitment-plus-dispatch cost and gas dispatch cost.

primary_variables.o_{generator}_{period}: <float> Whether the generator is on (1) or off (0) in each period, with period 0 being the fixed pre-horizon state.
primary_variables.vp_{generator}_{period}: <float> Whether the generator starts up at the beginning of each period.
primary_variables.vm_{generator}_{period}: <float> Whether the generator shuts down at the beginning of each period.
primary_variables.w_{generator}_{bid}_{period}: <float> Whether the given supply bid of the generator is selected in each period.
primary_variables.r_{generator}_{period}: <float> Startup cost incurred by the generator in each period.
primary_variables.phimax_{generator}_{period}: <float> Maximum allowable gas price at which the committed gas-fired power plant's scheduled output remains profitable in each period.
primary_variables.p_{generator}_{period}: <float> Real power output of the generator in each period, with period 0 being the fixed pre-horizon output.
primary_variables.se_{generator}_{bid}_{period}: <float> Real power output supplied by the given bid of the generator in each period.
primary_variables.f_{line}_{period}: <float> Real power flow on the transmission line from its from-bus to its to-bus in each period.
primary_variables.theta_{bus}_{period}: <float> Voltage angle at the bus in each period.
primary_variables.sg_{junction}_{period}: <float> Total gas supply provided at the junction in each period.
primary_variables.sgs_{junction}_{supply_interval}_{period: <float> Gas supply provided from the given supply interval of the source junction in each period.
primary_variables.pisq_{junction}_{period}: <float> Squared pressure at the gas junction in each period.
primary_variables.phig_{connection}_{period}: <float> Gas flow on the gas-network connection from its from-junction to its to-junction in each period.
primary_variables.lg_{junction}_{period}: <float> Satisfied gas demand at the junction in each period.
primary_variables.qg_{junction}_{period}: <float> Shed gas demand at the junction in each period.
primary_variables.gamma_{junction}_{period}: <float> Total gas consumed by gas-fired power plants at the junction in each period.
primary_variables.psi_{pricing_zone}_{period}: <float> Zonal gas price for the pricing zone in each period.
